news.titleEn: Nasdaq, S&P 500 lifted by Nvidia's forecast; investors eye speech by Fed's Warsh
news.conclusionEn: US stocks closed higher Thursday, with the Nasdaq Composite up about 1.6% to a record and the S&P 500 gaining 0.7%, after Nvidia jumped roughly 9% on a forecast that revenue will grow about 70% next fiscal year.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达大涨约9%带动纳指涨1.6%创新高，标普涨0.7%
news.whyEn: Nvidia's outlook, alongside strong results from Salesforce, Okta and CrowdStrike, reassured investors that AI-related spending is still accelerating and eased fears of an AI bubble, keeping the bull market intact.
news.whyZh: 英伟达指引加上多家软件、网络安全公司财报超预期，缓解AI泡沫担忧，支撑牛市。
news.detailEn: Nvidia, the world's most valuable company, said data-center demand for its Blackwell and coming Rubin chips is accelerating, and its fiscal-2028 revenue growth guidance of about 70% far exceeded the roughly 44% analysts expected. Chip peers Broadcom, Intel and SK Hynix also rose, while Salesforce surged more than 20% and cybersecurity names Okta and CrowdStrike gained 20% to 28% on strong reports. Technology was the only S&P 500 sector to advance meaningfully, underscoring how narrow the rally remains. Investors now turn to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech on Friday for clues on interest rates.
news.detailZh: 全球市值最高的英伟达表示，数据中心对其Blackwell及即将推出的Rubin芯片需求正在加速，2028财年营收增速指引约70%，远超分析师预期的约44%。博通、英特尔、SK海力士等芯片股跟涨，Salesforce飙升逾20%，网络安全公司Okta和CrowdStrike涨20%至28%。科技是当日标普500中唯一显著上涨的板块，凸显涨势依然狭窄。投资者转而关注美联储主席沃什周五在杰克逊霍尔的演讲以寻找利率线索。

news.titleEn: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh delivers his key Jackson Hole speech Friday. Here's what to expect
news.conclusionEn: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gives his first Jackson Hole keynote around 10 a.m. ET Friday, August 28, and is under pressure to clarify whether the Fed's next move could be a rate hike or a cut.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储主席沃什周五首次发表杰克逊霍尔主题演讲，市场关注下一步是加息还是降息
news.whyEn: With inflation still near 3.5% to 3.7%, Treasury yields around 4.7% and markets pricing roughly one-in-three odds of a September hike, Warsh's tone could set the direction for the dollar, bonds and equities into the September 16 FOMC meeting.
news.whyZh: 通胀仍近3.5%至3.7%、美债收益率约4.7%，市场押注9月加息概率约三分之一，演讲基调或左右9月议息前的美元、债市与股市走向。
news.detailEn: Warsh has kept the fed funds rate at 3.50% to 3.75% since succeeding Jerome Powell in May and has given markets little forward guidance, drawing criticism that his message is unclear. He has said his remarks will focus on long-term structural issues rather than near-term policy, and a BofA survey suggests investors expect a broadly neutral speech. Analysts think he may lean hawkish to satisfy inflation-focused colleagues, which could push yields higher and weigh on rate-sensitive stocks. Any dovish surprise would likely spark a rally in risk assets and a weaker dollar.
news.detailZh: 自5月接替鲍威尔以来，沃什将联邦基金利率维持在3.50%至3.75%，且很少给出前瞻指引，被批评立场不清晰。他表示演讲将聚焦长期结构性议题而非短期政策，美银调查显示投资者预期演讲基调偏中性。分析师认为他可能偏鹰以安抚关注通胀的同僚，这将推高收益率、打压利率敏感型股票；若意外偏鸽，则可能引发风险资产上涨、美元走弱。

news.titleEn: Canada issues retaliatory tariffs of up to 50 percent on U.S. imports
news.conclusionEn: Canada announced counter-tariffs of up to 50% on about 700 categories of U.S. goods worth roughly $20 billion a year, after Washington imposed 50% duties on $27.6 billion of Canadian products effective August 22.
news.conclusionZh: 加拿大对约700类、年值约200亿美元的美国商品加征最高50%关税反制
news.whyEn: The tit-for-tat escalation between the two closely integrated economies threatens cross-border supply chains in autos, steel, dairy and appliances and adds fresh upside risk to U.S. consumer prices.
news.whyZh: 两个高度融合经济体之间的对等升级，威胁汽车、钢铁、乳制品和家电的跨境供应链，并加大美国物价上行风险。
news.detailEn: Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada would match U.S. tariffs 'dollar for dollar' after trade talks collapsed over what he called Washington's 'uneconomic' demands. From September 8, Canada will double tariffs on American steel and aluminum to 50% and add duties on roughly 700 other products spanning appliances, agricultural equipment, plastics, pulp and paper, and electronics. U.S. duties on Canadian goods took effect August 22, hitting $27.6 billion of imports. Economists warn the dispute could shave growth on both sides of the border and keep goods inflation elevated into 2027.
news.detailZh: 加拿大总理卡尼表示，在谈判因华盛顿「不合经济」的要求而破裂后，加方将「以牙还牙」对等回应美国关税。自9月8日起，加拿大将对美国钢铝关税翻倍至50%，并对家电、农业机械、塑料、纸浆纸张和电子产品等约700种商品加征关税。美国对加拿大商品的关税已于8月22日生效，涉及276亿美元进口。经济学家警告，争端可能拖累边境两侧的经济增长，并使商品通胀在2027年前维持高位。

news.titleEn: Fed's Lisa Cook turns mortgage allegations back on Trump and his Cabinet
news.conclusionEn: A lawyer for Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook rejected President Trump's revived attempt to remove her over unproven mortgage-fraud claims, calling the allegations 'unfounded and untrue' just before a White House deadline.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储理事库克的律师驳回特朗普以未经证实的房贷指控将其解职的新一轮尝试
news.whyEn: The clash is a direct test of Federal Reserve independence weeks before a rate decision, and a successful removal would let Trump reshape the board that sets U.S. monetary policy.
news.whyZh: 此番冲突在议息前数周直接考验美联储独立性，一旦解职成功，特朗普将得以重塑制定货币政策的理事会。
news.detailEn: The White House gave Cook 21 days to respond to allegations that she misrepresented details on mortgage applications, reviving an effort the Supreme Court blocked on an emergency basis in June. Cook's attorney said the claims remain unsubstantiated and accused administration officials of similar discrepancies in their own filings. The Supreme Court is expected to hear the underlying case, Trump v. Cook, on its merits later this year. Investors see the standoff, along with Treasury pressure on long-term yields, as a growing risk to the central bank's credibility.
news.detailZh: 白宫给予库克21天时间回应其在房贷申请中虚报信息的指控，此举重启了最高法院6月紧急叫停的解职尝试。库克的律师称指控缺乏依据，并反指政府官员自己的文件也存在类似出入。最高法院预计将在今年晚些时候就「特朗普诉库克案」进行实体审理。投资者认为，这场对峙加上财政部对长期收益率的施压，正成为削弱央行公信力的风险。

news.titleEn: Putin Moves to Escalate War in Ukraine as Talks at Dead End
news.conclusionEn: Russia is preparing to intensify its offensive in Ukraine after concluding that U.S.-brokered peace negotiations have stalled, according to people close to the Kremlin, as both sides traded heavy strikes on energy sites.
news.conclusionZh: 克里姆林宫人士称，判定和谈陷入僵局后，俄罗斯正准备加大对乌攻势
news.whyEn: A renewed escalation would prolong a war that has repeatedly disrupted global energy and grain markets, and dims hopes for the ceasefire Washington has spent months trying to broker.
news.whyZh: 战事重新升级将延长这场屡屡扰动全球能源与粮食市场的战争，也令华盛顿数月斡旋的停火希望渺茫。
news.detailEn: Kremlin-linked figures said President Vladimir Putin believes he can extract better terms by pressing Russia's battlefield advantage rather than settling now. Ukraine launched an hours-long drone barrage on Kyiv overnight into August 27 that damaged residential buildings, while Ukrainian strikes hit Russian oil refineries in Ufa and elsewhere. Russian attacks knocked out power in seven settlements in the Poltava region and targeted industrial and energy facilities. Diesel prices in Russia have climbed toward records amid the sustained refinery outages.
news.detailZh: 与克里姆林宫关系密切的人士表示，普京认为凭借战场优势施压比现在达成协议能换取更好条件。乌克兰在8月27日凌晨对基辅发动持续数小时的无人机袭击，损坏多栋居民楼；乌方打击也命中乌法等地的俄罗斯炼油厂。俄军攻击导致波尔塔瓦州七个居民点断电，并瞄准工业和能源设施。在炼厂持续停产之下，俄罗斯柴油价格已升向历史高位。

news.titleEn: China unveils targeted measures to aid slowing economy amid louder calls for policy support
news.conclusionEn: China's finance ministry and top economic planner rolled out fresh measures to boost spending on cars and home renovations and to expand loan-interest subsidies for small businesses, after July activity data missed expectations.
news.conclusionZh: 中国财政部等部门推出刺激汽车和家装消费、扩大小微企业贴息的新措施
news.whyEn: As the world's second-largest economy loses momentum, Beijing's incremental support affects global demand for commodities, industrial goods and consumer brands, and shapes expectations for bigger fiscal stimulus later this year.
news.whyZh: 作为全球第二大经济体动能放缓，北京的渐进式支持影响全球对大宗商品、工业品和消费品牌的需求，也影响年内更大规模财政刺激的预期。
news.detailEn: Manufacturing, consumption and investment all slowed more than forecast in July, intensifying calls from economists for stronger action. The measures expand interest subsidies on loans to small and micro enterprises and consumers, effective from August, and pledge further steps later in the year. Officials have also signaled plans to issue an additional 2 trillion yuan of bonds in the second half and opened applications for an 800 billion yuan program to fund local-government projects. Analysts say the piecemeal approach may not be enough to hit the roughly 5% growth target without a larger package.
news.detailZh: 7月制造业、消费和投资增速均低于预期，经济学家呼吁加大力度。新措施自8月起扩大对小微企业和消费者贷款的贴息，并承诺年内出台更多举措。官员还释放信号，计划下半年增发2万亿元债券，并启动8000亿元支持地方政府项目的资金申请。分析师认为，若无更大规模的一揽子计划，这种零敲碎打的方式可能不足以实现约5%的增长目标。

news.titleEn: Current price of oil as of August 27, 2026
news.conclusionEn: Oil prices eased on August 27, with Brent near $87 and U.S. WTI around $83 a barrel, after Iran's military said it reached a revenue-sharing agreement with Oman over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗宣布与阿曼就霍尔木兹海峡通航达成分成协议，8月27日油价回落
news.whyEn: Signs that traffic through Hormuz — a route for about a fifth of the world's oil — could normalize are draining the geopolitical risk premium from crude, easing one source of upward pressure on global inflation.
news.whyZh: 承载全球约五分之一石油运输的霍尔木兹海峡通行有望恢复正常，地缘风险溢价消退，缓解全球通胀上行压力之一。
news.detailEn: Futures reversed earlier gains after Tehran signaled a de-escalation in the standoff that has disrupted Gulf shipping since the Iran war began in February. Brent traded around $87 and WTI near $83, leaving the Brent-WTI spread near $4.75. Qatar's prime minister visited Tehran to revive mediation, and a Greek-operated air-defense system in Saudi Arabia intercepted another drone swarm near the Yanbu refining hub, underscoring lingering risk. Lower crude has helped pull U.S. Treasury yields back from multi-decade highs.
news.detailZh: 在德黑兰释放缓和信号后，原油期货回吐早盘涨幅；自2月伊朗战争爆发以来，海湾航运一直受扰。布伦特原油交投于约87美元，WTI约83美元，两者价差约4.75美元。卡塔尔首相访问德黑兰以重启斡旋，沙特由希腊人员操作的防空系统在延布炼油枢纽附近再次拦截无人机群，显示风险犹存。油价走低有助于美债收益率从数十年高位回落。

news.titleEn: Nike Names Walmart Alum Jane Ewing as Chief Commercial Officer
news.conclusionEn: Nike hired longtime Walmart executive Jane Ewing as executive vice president and chief commercial officer, effective September 7, months after eliminating the role, as it tries to engineer a turnaround with the stock near a 12-year low.
news.conclusionZh: 耐克聘请沃尔玛资深高管尤因出任首席商务官，9月7日上任，助力扭转颓势
news.whyEn: Nike is the world's largest sportswear brand and a bellwether for consumer spending; bringing in retail operating expertise signals how deep its sales and inventory problems have become.
news.whyZh: 耐克是全球最大运动服饰品牌、消费风向标；引入零售运营专才，凸显其销售与库存问题之深。
news.detailEn: Ewing spent nearly 14 years at Walmart in roles including interim CEO of Sam's Club China and senior vice president of international operations and of sustainability. At Nike she will run the global marketplace group, covering wholesale and Nike Direct, and is charged with rebuilding retail-partner relationships and improving digital and in-store execution. Nike revived the chief commercial officer position it had cut in a leadership overhaul earlier this year. The stock has slid to levels last seen more than a decade ago amid falling sales and heavy promotions.
news.detailZh: 尤因在沃尔玛工作近14年，曾任山姆会员店中国区临时首席执行官、国际业务及可持续发展高级副总裁。在耐克，她将执掌涵盖批发与Nike Direct的全球市场部门，负责重建零售伙伴关系、改善线上与门店运营。耐克恢复了今年早些时候在领导层重组中裁撤的首席商务官职位。在销售下滑和大力促销之下，其股价已跌至十多年来的低点。

news.titleEn: Marvell Technology Forecasts Quarterly Revenue Above Estimates on AI Chip Demand
news.conclusionEn: Marvell Technology forecast current-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates and beat on adjusted profit at $0.94 a share, citing strong demand for the custom chips and networking gear used in AI data centers.
news.conclusionZh: 芯片商Marvell季度营收指引超预期，调整后每股利润0.94美元胜预期
news.whyEn: Marvell is a key supplier of custom AI silicon to hyperscalers, so its upbeat guidance adds to evidence from Nvidia that data-center spending is still climbing rather than plateauing.
news.whyZh: Marvell是超大规模云厂商定制AI芯片的关键供应商，其乐观指引与英伟达一道印证数据中心投入仍在攀升而非见顶。
news.detailEn: The company guided fiscal 2027 revenue to nearly $11.5 billion, up about 40% year over year, and pointed to roughly $16.5 billion for fiscal 2028 as custom-silicon programs with cloud customers ramp. Adjusted earnings of $0.94 topped the $0.92 consensus. The results landed the day after Nvidia's forecast and alongside strong reports from Salesforce, Okta and CrowdStrike, reinforcing the AI-infrastructure trade. Marvell shares had already run up sharply into the print on expectations of a beat.
news.detailZh: 公司将2027财年营收指引定为近115亿美元，同比增长约40%，并预计随着与云客户的定制芯片项目放量，2028财年营收约165亿美元。调整后每股收益0.94美元，高于0.92美元的市场共识。财报在英伟达指引次日公布，与Salesforce、Okta和CrowdStrike的强劲业绩一道，强化了AI基础设施交易。受益于市场对超预期的押注，Marvell股价在财报前已大幅上涨。

news.titleEn: Dollar and bond markets 'on edge' ahead of Jackson Hole as Bessent's market intervention piles pressure on Warsh
news.conclusionEn: The U.S. dollar and Treasury market were jittery into Friday's Jackson Hole speech, with the 10-year yield near 4.7% and the dollar down about 0.8% in August, as the Treasury's bond-buyback plans complicate the Fed's job.
news.conclusionZh: 杰克逊霍尔演讲前美元与美债市场紧张，10年期收益率近4.7%
news.whyEn: Investors worry that friction between a rate-cut-seeking White House and Treasury and a cautious Fed is undermining confidence in U.S. assets, a dynamic that has helped push gold up more than 15% this month.
news.whyZh: 投资者担忧寻求降息的白宫、财政部与谨慎的美联储之间的摩擦正削弱对美国资产的信心，这也推动金价本月上涨逾15%。
news.detailEn: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has expanded buybacks of older long-dated bonds to hold down borrowing costs, a step some strategists view as encroaching on monetary policy. Long-term yields have stayed elevated on doubts about the Fed's resolve on inflation, even as the dollar weakened. Warsh is expected to defend Fed independence while giving little ground on near-term rate guidance. A hawkish message could lift the dollar and pressure stocks, while any hint of future cuts would likely do the opposite.
news.detailZh: 美国财政部长贝森特扩大了对存量长期债券的回购，以压低融资成本，一些策略师认为此举侵入了货币政策领域。尽管美元走弱，但因市场质疑美联储抗通胀的决心，长期收益率仍居高不下。预计沃什将捍卫美联储独立性，同时在短期利率指引上少有让步。偏鹰的表态可能提振美元、打压股市，而任何未来降息的暗示则可能带来相反效果。

businessTips.explanationEn: Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative you give up when you choose one option over another. Every decision to spend time, money or attention on something is also a decision not to spend it elsewhere, so the real cost of a choice includes that forgone alternative, not just the cash outlay. Thinking in terms of opportunity cost helps you compare options honestly — a 'free' project that consumes your best engineers for a month isn't free if those engineers could have built something more valuable. It is one of the most practical ideas in economics for everyday business judgment.
businessTips.explanationZh: 机会成本，是指当你在多个选项中选择其一时，所放弃的最佳备选方案的价值。任何把时间、金钱或精力投入某件事的决定，同时也是不把它们投入别处的决定；因此一个选择的真实成本，包含这个被放弃的备选，而不只是现金支出。用机会成本思考，能帮你诚实地比较选项——一个「免费」的项目如果占用你最好的工程师一个月，就并不免费，因为这些人本可以做出更有价值的东西。这是经济学中对日常商业判断最实用的观念之一。
businessTips.exampleEn: A founder is offered a $30,000 consulting contract that would take six weeks of her time. It looks like pure upside until she realizes those same six weeks were earmarked for launching a new product line projected to earn $150,000 over the next year. The consulting fee's opportunity cost is the delayed launch, so she turns it down or hires someone else to take the contract.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位创业者收到一份为期六周、报酬3万美元的咨询合同。乍看只有好处，直到她意识到这六周原本计划用于推出一条新产品线，预计未来一年可带来15万美元收入。这笔咨询费的机会成本就是被推迟的新品发布，于是她拒绝了合同，或另雇他人承接。

businessTips.explanationEn: Pre-selling means taking real orders or payments for a product or service before you have fully built it. Instead of spending months creating something and hoping people want it, you describe the offer, ask people to buy now (often at a discount), and only build it in earnest once enough have committed. It validates demand with the strongest possible signal — money — and can fund the work itself. If almost no one pre-orders, you have cheaply saved yourself from building the wrong thing.
businessTips.explanationZh: 预售，是指在产品或服务尚未完全做出来之前，就接受真实的订单或付款。你不再花几个月做出东西再祈祷有人想要，而是先描述这个方案，请人们现在就购买（通常给折扣），等到有足够多的人下单后再正式开发。它用最强的信号——真金白银——来验证需求，还能为开发本身提供资金。如果几乎没人预订，你也用很低的成本避免了做错方向。
businessTips.exampleEn: Someone planning an online course on financial modeling writes a one-page description, sets a price of $120 with a 'founding student' discount, and shares it with their newsletter. Forty people pay within a week, giving $4,800 to fund production and clear proof the topic sells. Had only three signed up, they would pivot the topic before recording a single lesson.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一个打算做「财务建模」线上课程的人，写了一页课程说明，定价120美元并设「首批学员」折扣，发给自己的邮件订阅者。一周内40人付费，带来4800美元用于制作，也清楚证明了这个主题能卖。若只有3人报名，他会在录制任何一节课之前就调整主题。

businessTips.explanationEn: Compound interest is the return you earn not just on your original money but also on the returns it has already generated. Because each period's gain is added to the base that earns the next period's gain, growth accelerates over time rather than staying flat. The two things that matter most are the rate of return and, even more, the number of years you let it run — which is why starting early with modest sums often beats starting later with larger ones. The same math works against you on debt, where unpaid interest compounds into a larger balance.
businessTips.explanationZh: 复利，是指你不仅从本金上获得回报，还从已经产生的回报上继续获得回报。由于每一期的收益都被加入到本金基数中、再去赚取下一期收益，增长会随时间加速，而不是保持线性。最重要的两个因素是收益率，以及更为关键的——你让它滚动的年数；这也是为什么「早一点、小额起步」往往胜过「晚一点、大额起步」。同样的数学在债务上会反过来对你不利：未偿还的利息会滚成更大的欠款。
businessTips.exampleEn: Two people each invest in a fund that averages 7% a year. One puts in $300 a month from age 25 to 35 and then never adds another dollar; the other starts at 35 and contributes $300 a month for 30 years straight. By age 65 the early starter, despite paying in far less in total, often ends up with a comparable or larger balance — purely because their money compounded for a decade longer.
businessTips.exampleZh: 两个人都投资于一只年均回报7%的基金。一人从25岁到35岁每月投入300美元，之后再不追加；另一人从35岁开始、连续30年每月投入300美元。到65岁时，尽管早开始的人投入总额少得多，最终的账户余额却往往与对方相当甚至更多——仅仅因为他的钱多复利了十年。
